claims: Assess and manage agitation/delirium (RASS +3, CAM-ICU positive) with nonpharmacologic measures and cautious pharmacologic therapy as needed.
Monitor blood glucose closely and treat hyperglycemia with insulin per sliding scale.
Monitor renal function and urine output given acute kidney injury (creatinine 2.0-2.2 mg/dL, BUN 60 mg/dL).
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit and transfuse packed red blood cells if clinically indicated for anemia (Hb 8.9-9.3 g/dL).
Monitor ionized calcium and supplement calcium gluconate per sliding scale for hypocalcemia (ionized calcium 1.06 mmol/L).
Monitor coagulation parameters (PT/INR, PTT, fibrinogen) and correct coagulopathy as needed (INR 1.6).
Monitor blood pressure and titrate phenylephrine infusion to maintain adequate mean arterial pressure (recent MAP 68-77 mmHg).
Monitor oxygen saturation and respiratory status, adjusting oxygen therapy to maintain SpO2 ≥92% (recent SpO2 93-96%).
Monitor electrolytes (sodium 130-136 mEq/L, potassium 4.0-4.3 mEq/L, magnesium 1.8-1.9 mg/dL) and replace as needed.
Perform daily assessment of skin integrity and implement pressure ulcer prevention measures given Braden score indicating risk.
